sessionFiles.kimi-home/config.toml:
default_model = "probe-model"
default_permission_mode = "ask"
telemetry = false

[providers.probe]
type = "openai_legacy"
base_url = "${MOCK_LLM_URL}"
api_key = "probe-mock-key"

[models.probe-model]
provider = "probe"
model = "probe-model"
capabilities = ["tool_use"]

notes: KIMI_CODE_HOME relocates kimi's data dir into the probe workspace. Documented limitation (moonshotai/kimi-code#1330): kimi acp's session gate only accepts the OAuth token file — BYO-LLM providers cannot create sessions even with a probe token, so turn-dependent cells fail as 'requires Moonshot OAuth — not CI-probeable'.
